commitNote: The snapshot this was taken from carried no git metadata; it is pinned by its pyproject version and by the file hashes below.

modifications: re-implemented in TypeScript over the TypeScript compiler AST (if, ?:, loops, catch, case, &&/||/?? and their assignment forms)
Python/Go/Java/Rust estimated from decision keywords over Feature 1 function ranges (labelled heuristic)
severity bands mapped to Fehm severities: ≤15 low, ≤25 medium, else high
mapped onto TypeScript syntax; switch treated like match; nested functions are measured on their own instead of contributing at nesting 0
not computed for heuristic languages
switch adds a level; else-if and top-level try do not (as upstream)
indentation (Python) and control-brace (Go/Java/Rust) approximations
thresholds kept (5 params, 50 lines, 20 methods, 15 attributes, 500 lines); class members counted from the Fehm graph
severity and dimension weights and the magnitude formula kept
Fehm adds git churn, fix commits, working-tree changes and missing test protection to priority
hotspot levels are relative to the codebase (top 5% / 25%) with absolute floors; no project-wide percentage score
verdict states definitely/likely/possibly unused, external API, framework entry point, dynamic reference
keep-alive checks over the Fehm graph, decorators, package exports, string/config mentions and unresolved textual mentions
Fehm rule ids; the Skylos id each rule corresponds to is recorded and shown on the finding

adaptations.upstream: skylos/rules/danger/taint.py, untrusted_sources.py (SKY-D211/212/215/216/228/230/233/234 and their source model)
modifications: re-implemented for TypeScript/JavaScript on the TypeScript compiler AST: request, LLM-response and MCP/agent-tool-argument sources; per-sink sanitizers; parameterized SQL; one call level across files via the Fehm graph
Python: line-level flows within a function (heuristic), route-decorator parameters as sources as upstream does

adaptations.upstream: skylos/rules/secrets.py (SKY-S101/S102): provider patterns, keyed-value rule, placeholder markers, public client env prefixes
modifications: values never leave the scanner: kind, length and a SHA-256 fingerprint only; excerpts are redacted
entropy floor for keyed values; OpenAI/Anthropic keys, JWTs and credentials in connection URLs added
lockfile checksum handling reduced to excluding lockfiles

adaptations.upstream: skylos/rules/catalog.py (D2xx danger rules, D290–D312 GitHub Actions, D314–D323 GitLab, D330/D342/D343 containers, D240–D244 MCP, D246–D253, D260–D267 LLM)
modifications: Fehm rule ids with the Skylos id recorded as upstream
line-level checks over the files 3.2 classifies; findings grouped per rule with every occurrence as evidence

adaptations.upstream: skylos/defend/owasp.py and defend/plugins (tool schema/scope, dangerous sinks, untrusted input to prompt, output validation, PII filter, model pinning, cost controls, rate limiting, logging)
modifications: reported as the share of call sites or tools with evidence of each control, not a score
OWASP LLM 2025 and Agentic 2026 category names kept; mapping is evidence toward a category, never compliance

notUsed: The Python analyzer itself, LLM review and investigator, agent hooks and command guard, runtime agent verification, remediation engine, attestation, SBOM writer (Fehm has its own), cloud upload, benchmarks, VS Code extension and Rust engine.
